<!--
Measured, not read: a table set in the text flow begins on the page its
title and caption are on.

longtable breaks the page itself, ahead of the table, when its head and first
row do not fit on what is left of the page; the title and caption had already
been set, and were left alone at the page's foot with the table over the
page. \nopagebreak after the caption could not stop it. Now the title and
caption go over with the table, and only when they must: \apatablekeep asks
for their own height and three lines more, not the fourteen lines of a guess,
which in double spacing would send any table in the lower half of a page to
the next.

Each table starts a page of its own after a counted run of lines, so where it
falls does not depend on the others. With a caption of one line, 21 lines
leave room for the title, caption, head and first row, and 22 do not; with a
caption of two lines, 20 and 21. The tables after 22 and 21 lines were the
ones stranded. The tables after 21 and 20 lines must stay where they are:
a measure asking for more room than a table's start takes would send them
over too.
-->
